<cite ref="Nedarim 77a:5">Ib.</cite>, sq. <he>א׳ ליה רב וכ׳</he> Rab attended to Rabbah’s vows in a private room of the school-house &c.—Y. Keth. II, 26ᶜ bot. <he>אִיזְדְּקזּקֵי וכ׳</he> to sleep with &c.
